title: AviShifo AI
description: Ask about your clinic in plain language — answers come from your own data.
placeholder: For example: how much revenue this month?
examples: How much revenue did we take this month?
Show the 5 patients who owe the most
Which doctor saw the most patients last week?
How many appointments are booked for today?
privacyNote: The assistant sees only your clinic's data, and only the areas you already have access to. It has no route to any other clinic's data at all.
disabledTitle: AviShifo AI is not enabled yet
disabledBody: A Gemini API key must be configured on the server. Ask your administrator.
